name: get_profile
description: Kiara's profile: city, workdays, office dress norms, and anything she has told FitCheck about her preferences.

name: get_closet
description: The pieces in her closet, with category, color, dress level, warmth (1 light to 3 warm), rain-readiness, days since last worn (-1 means never), and when each was added.

category.description: Optional: Tops, Bottoms, Dresses, Outerwear, Shoes, or Accessories

name: get_events
description: Her upcoming events between two dates (read-only): title, day, and start time.

name: get_forecast
description: The forecast for her city between two dates: condition, high and low (Celsius and Fahrenheit), and chance of rain. Days beyond the forecast are listed as not covered.

name: get_plan
description: The looks already in her FitCheck calendar between two dates, with who planned each one (her or the agent) and whether it was worn.

name: pencil_in_look
description: Pencil a look into a day of her FitCheck calendar, built only from pieces in her closet.

occasion.description: work, dinner, date, casual, or party

why.description: One line: why this look for this day

calendar.description: Which calendar to write to. Defaults to fitcheck.

name: replace_look
description: Replace the pieces in a look already in her FitCheck calendar.

name: remove_look
description: Remove a look from her FitCheck calendar.

name: mark_worn
description: Mark a planned look as worn, which records wear dates on its pieces.

name: ask_user
description: Ask Kiara a question and wait for her answer.

name: send_readback
description: Send Kiara the weekly plan readback.
